entities.name: Tan Jolom
entities.description: The Worldwalker, first Komon Winaq to circumnavigate the Core of Paradise; he became an Echo and passed into the afterlife.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: People of Ixalan whose first legend was Tan Jolom.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: Final child of the Fourth People, the whisperer who convinced Tan Jolom to pass beyond death.

entities.name: Deep Gods
entities.description: Chimil's children Tan Jolom searched for.

entities.name: Fourth People
entities.description: People whose land Aclazotz promised to show Tan Jolom.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Stored Jolom's helm in a vault on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane where Jolom's helm was stored.

entities.name: Core of Paradise
entities.description: Core of Ixalan around a star.

events.summary: Tan Jolom completes the first circumnavigation of the Core of Paradise, confirming the world is a sphere built around a star.
events.quote: Tan Jolom was the first of the Komon Winaq to complete a circumnavigation

events.summary: Aclazotz convinces Jolom to pass beyond the veil of death, and he becomes an Echo and departs for the afterlife.
events.quote: Aclazotz convinced him to pass beyond the veil of death

events.summary: Dark creatures slip into the world through the door Tan Jolom left open, most terrible of all Aclazotz.
events.quote: Dark creatures from the afterlife slipped into the world through the door left open by Tan Jolom

events.summary: The Coin Empire stores Jolom's helm in a vault on Thunder Junction, where it is released around 4563 AR.
events.quote: the Coin Empire stored Jolom's helm in a vault on the plane of Thunder Junction

relations.note: Persuaded him to pass into the afterlife.
relations.quote: Aclazotz convinced him to pass beyond the veil of death
